title: XYZ FORGE: FROM SPECIFIED WORK TO VERIFIED DELIVERY
subtitle: How a task moves through intake, planning, one execution mode, verification gates and delivery, and what each stage records.

stages.label: Intake & prioritization
stages.caption: Captures specified work, scores the backlog and selects the target repository.

stages.label: Planning & preflight
stages.caption: Groups compatible work into waves; checks dependencies, path conflicts and readiness.

stages.label: Execution harness
stages.caption: Runs each task in one of four modes.

stages.label: Verification gates
stages.caption: Tests, doc checks and review evidence. Pass, send back, or escalate.

stages.label: Delivery & reconciliation
stages.caption: Lands verified work through the authorized PR workflow, then records it.

external.label: GitHub
external.caption: Issues, pull requests and hosted CI. Not the coordination bus.

skills: Reusable skills: operator and agent procedures, available at every stage

workspaces.label: Scoped workspaces
workspaces.caption: Path allowlists, timeouts, controlled commits. Worktree or clone per lane.

adapters.label: Agent CLI adapters
adapters.caption: Codex, agy, Claude Code; also CommandCode, DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen.

tick.label: tick kernel
tick.caption: Coordination kernel: local event log to derived state; locks, claims, turn ownership.

edges.deliverRec: records evidence, updates ledger and status

entries.label: PDDA project documents
entries.caption: Plans, status, handoff context. Governs; does not dispatch.

entries.label: Review & run evidence
entries.caption: Relay threads, test receipts, telemetry. tick owns turns, not content.

footer.note: Schematic: shows control and record flows, not deployment topology or timing. Icons are hand-drawn vectors; no images were generated.
footer.source: Redrawn from the XYZ Forge system diagram (HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge) in the visual language of the October 12 belief-updating reference.
